description: Current US mortgage and HELOC rates refreshed daily from lenders' own published rate pages, grouped by loan type (e.g. '30-year fixed', '15-year fixed', 'HELOC'), each with note rate, APR, representative-scenario assumptions, observation timestamp, source URL, and staleness status. Coverage reflects observed national and multi-state lenders (availability varies by state licensing; no third-party national-average benchmark is redistributed). Pass loan_type to filter to one type or omit for all; optional loan_amount, state, and credit_score add educational/licensing context without fabricating personal rates. Use for observed lender mortgage and HELOC rate tables; use compare_home_equity_payments to model monthly payment schedules from explicit rate, balance, and term assumptions. Factual rate data only; does not produce personalized quotes, imply approval, or endorse lenders. Pass max_results to cap the number of rows and include_provenance=false for a shorter response.

credit_score.description: FICO — returns EDUCATIONAL context only; never a fabricated credit-adjusted rate

include_provenance.description: false omits the per-source provenance block (snapshot ids, attributions); each row keeps its own observed_at and source_url.

loan_amount.description: Loan amount in USD — compares with the 2026 one-unit baseline conforming loan limit; county/unit limits and eligibility require separate verification (does not fabricate a rate)

loan_type.description: Loan type to filter to, e.g. '30-year fixed', '15-year fixed', or 'HELOC'. Omit for all.

max_results.description: Cap the number of observed rows returned, in the payload's ordering. Omit for all.

state.description: Two-letter state — adds an availability/licensing note

name: get_mortgage_rates

as_of.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the normalized mortgage rate cache.

observed.description: Observed lender mortgage and HELOC rates grouped by loan type with note rate, APR, scenario assumptions, observed_at, source_url, and staleness.

title: Get current US mortgage rates
